manual.title: Read the official Tampere HTI posting's security/export-control clause and determine which of the 2-5 roles are affected
manual.notes: Official source: https://tuni.rekrytointi.com/paikat/?jgid=3&jid=3110&o=A_RJ The posting states some projects may be subject to legal, sanctions or export-control restrictions. Determine scope and whether the applicant's nationality is affected; update restricted_position_eligibility in constraints.yaml afterwards. Blocks the apply decision.
